content: We combine both data sources (i.e., editor tags and Amazon search terms) using a round-robin combination strategy, which ensures an equal weight for both sources. This gives us three additional popularity-based algorithms (= INLINEFORM0 , INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 ).
